why: On the e3 path the flag governs, ZERO gap-1 games are exact-FAIL+cell_recall-PASS: the LLM/DSL-induced dynamics have cell_recall ~0 (cn04 0.0146, cd82 0.0, sc25 0.0547) -- they are WRONG, not imperfect-but-useful, so neither gate trusts them and flipping changes no decision -> identical agent -> identical first-win.
